newsitem.title: JAPAN: High-tech shares fall on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: High-tech shares fall on profit-taking.

text.p: Semiconductor-related shares lost ground in Monday morning trade as participants sold to take profits, brokers said.
Shares in Advantest Corp were 120 yen lower at 6,490 at 0132 GMT. Matsushita-Kotobuki Electronics Industries Ltd shares were down 70 yen 3,440 at 0136 GMT.
Shares in Tokyo Electron Ltd were down 90 yen at 4,020 at 0140 GMT.

"For medium-term investors, prices of high-tech shares have risen to a desirable level for profit-taking. Some investors expect high-tech issues to decline about 10 percent from recent highs," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said.
Participants also continued to take profits in Canon Inc and Sony Co, brokers said.
